author: Myv
body:
Hello, I'm BeanFive a.k.a Myv, member of the Jalapenos Team.

We are participating in the Battle of Eternity tournament and are looking for more members who will be active and able to be a great contribution to our team in time to come and for other tournaments.

We scrim rather regularly - we try to scrim every day, sometimes scrimming other teams or having fun in our team. More often than not, though, we scrim between ourselves because we feel it is easier to practice. 

Requirements:

  • Friendliness and willingness to chat amongst team
  • Some sort of skill, whether it be sword combat or using a bow, or even things like bridging and defense.
  • No amount of monuments or kills are required.
  • A timezone close to BST/GMT would be preferable but not totally necessary, because of tournament times.
  • Skype is preferable and helpful to us all, Teamspeak will be necessary for the future. We recommend having both if you can possibly do this.
Applications

If you want to apply as a rusher for our team, please fill out this application below:
https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/87LKLJH 

If you want to apply as a defender for out team, please fill out this application below: (in demand, higher chance of being accepted)
https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/8VM3PWD

Best of luck in applications, we hope to see you on our team!

N.B: Please contact Patrikano or Avatar_gaming for more information, who are the leaders.
